table1.title: Table 1. Study populations, source windows, and analytic frames
table1.note: AIH and SAEH counts are administrative admission records, not unique persons. Mexico's raw 40,907 records were filtered to 40,415 by valid-state eligibility; 33 additional records from the 2023 discharge source yield 40,448 without extending admission dates. The exposure-complete municipality branch contains 39,809 records and is not the expanded state cohort. Fitted rows exclude lag warm-up and non-informative fixed-effect strata. Full stratification and inference specifications are in Supplementary Table S4.

table2.title: Table 2. Temperature, fire-source PM₂.₅, and compound-day comparisons
table2.note: All effect estimates are RRs with 95% CIs. Units, lag windows, references, and model-row counts remain in each row. Complete sensitivity variants are in Supplementary Table S5E; the exploratory Brazilian K85/K81/K80 compound-day family is in S5C. The diagnosis-code comparisons are compound-day contrasts, not continuous temperature effects. The compound-day RR and multiplicative interaction are different estimands.

table3.title: Table 3. Urgent care and healthcare-service burden
table3.note: Urgent/elective rows are ratios of heat-only RRs. The next four rows compare heat-only with neither days; per-admission reimbursement is a conditional geometric-mean ratio. The final two rows are cumulative temperature RRs per 1°C over lag 0–7. Urgency, urgent-admission, hospital-day, total-reimbursement and drainage models include calendar adjustment and two-way health-region/date clustering. Per-admission reimbursement uses a separate positive-region-day log-linear model with health-region clusters and normal intervals, without calendar adjustment. Stone extraction (†) uses health-region clusters, calendar adjustment and normal intervals. Pandemic-exclusion fits retain 2018–2019 and 2022. Additional samples and estimates are in Supplementary Tables S1 and S5; full output is in Supplementary Data. An em dash indicates a sensitivity that was not estimated.
